name: specd
description: specd — spec-driven delivery platform. Connect, Ground, Spec, human gate, Build, Learn.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" build && pnpm --filter @specd/api build && pnpm --filter @specd/web build
scripts.cli:build: cd cli && go build -o ../bin/specd ./cmd/specd && echo "built → ./bin/specd  (run 'pnpm cli:install' to put it on your PATH)"
scripts.cli:test: cd cli && go vet ./... && go test ./...
